plan.name: 12-Week Strength Program (Meniscus-Safe)
plan.description: 12-week progressive strength program for a 36-year-old male recreational lifter cleared for low-impact strength work. Avoids jumping and deep knee flexion under load. Goal: increase strength and prepare for next ski season.

goals.name: Increase strength
goals.description: Improve compound strength across squat alternatives, hinge, and upper-body pushes/pulls while protecting the repaired meniscus.

goals.name: Return to skiing readiness
goals.description: Build reliable lower-body strength and single-leg control without loading into deep flexion or plyometrics.

activities.name: Rear-foot elevated split squat (to limited depth)
Leg press - shallow range (no deep flexion)
Weighted step-ups (tall box, limited knee bend)
